verdict.rationale: LibreChat exposes an Agent Management API (labelled beta) and publishes an openapi.json, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. An OpenAPI spec and a beta API are adjacent facts and do not establish versioned APIs with a deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
